reasoning: The vulnerability CVE-GHSA-qwcr-r2fm-qrc7 affects body-parser version 1.20.1, which is present as a nested transitive dependency under express 4.18.2. While the root project lists body-parser 1.20.2 as a direct dependency, express explicitly pins body-parser to 1.20.1 in its node_modules structure. A simple direct upgrade in package.json will not resolve the nested instance under express. Therefore, a transitive override is necessary to force npm to resolve body-parser to version 1.20.3 across the entire dependency graph without requiring a major version upgrade of express.
